checks.detail: Pass. Fresh Tester observations were bound to the exact candidate path and Godot 4.7 main scene. The candidate booted without editor errors, runtime debugger breaks, black frames, missing resources, or fatal failures. Its 1280x720 gameplay frames show a visible enclosed placeholder room with floor, walls, ceiling, neutral lighting, stable framing, and asymmetric cyan/amber orientation cues. Source and spatial inspection found native primitive meshes, collision-backed boundaries, one active Camera3D, and no authored map, production weapon/hands, HUD, minimap, enemy package, decorative collection, or runtime-download dependency. The supplied effect-imagination image is correctly treated as later-phase direction; only its current-phase framing, exposure, and scale-readability concerns apply.

Fail. Fresh runtime input proved physical WASD movement, independent horizontal and vertical mouse-look deltas, bounded pitch, stable camera framing, ui_cancel capture release, explicit-click reacquisition without a transform or camera jump, and reset restoration to the exact initial position, velocity, yaw, pitch, and captured state. The earlier physical-only Escape result is discarded as a probe-semantics mismatch because ui_cancel is a logical action and the ordinary action probe succeeded. The remaining defect is the inspected and runtime-confirmed restart binding: project.godot assigns restart to physical R instead of F6, and R reset the displaced and rotated player. This violates the active FPS input-integrity contract requiring R to remain reload-only.

Issue one narrow bootstrap verdict for the launchable placeholder loop. Accept only a real runnable shell and basic camera/input evidence; do not expand this first phase into map import, weapon implementation, HUD, minimap, enemy AI or final presentation.

required_criteria.requirement: Launch a minimal native Godot prototype with a simple bounded placeholder room, a player camera and ordinary keyboard/mouse input. This is an intentionally rough first increment: do not import the authored FPS map, real weapon or hand assets, HUD package, minimap package, enemy package or decorative asset collection. Verify the game starts without a black screen, missing-resource error or direct dependency on final content.

Use ordinary input to look and move the placeholder player inside the bounded prototype. Require stable camera framing, a visible floor, predictable input capture/release and a deterministic restart state. Placeholder geometry is permitted and expected; production scale, authored landmarks, weapons, HUD and map quality are explicitly out of scope.
